TextView.android:text:
KamuiNet allows you to share your internet connection with other devices over a secure P2P tunnel.

Step 1: On the device WITH internet, tap 'Share my internet'. A QR code will appear.

Step 2: On the other device, tap 'Receive internet'.

Step 3: Choose 'Scan QR Code' and scan the QR code from the first device.

Step 4: The VPN will start. Wait for the notification to say 'P2P Tunnel active'.

Note: Both devices should ideally be signed in with the same account for the best experience. If you are behind a strict firewall, connection may take a few seconds.
